title: A Primer of the Throwing Star
summary: Teaches an untrained beginner the pinch grip and first flat throws of the small bladed star with no qi.

title: Handbook of the Flat Blade Grip
summary: Shows how to hold draw and fling a flat bladed star from the hand sash or palm using body strength alone.

title: First Lessons in Star Throwing
summary: A short course in level and underhand releases plus a simple block for students who have only just begun.

title: The Pocket Star Drill-Book
summary: Drills students in pulling stars from a pocket and throwing from awkward positions with muscle and breath only.

title: Workbook of Thrown Points
summary: Exercises that train a straight point-first flight and quick dodging for bodies already strong in the tendons.

title: A Short Treatise on the Spinning Star
summary: Introduces students who circulate their own qi to spin the star faster and read its flight through the air.

title: Reader of Star Flight and Range
summary: Explains how far a thrown star carries and how to choose a short or lofted throw for each distance.

title: The Sleeve Star Canon
summary: Teaches carrying stars hidden in the cuff and loosing them quickly with a light thread of qi.

title: Basic Rules of the Star in Hand
summary: Covers using the star as a held cutting and stabbing tool when the target is too close to throw at.

title: Notes on Many-Pointed Throwing
summary: Compares four six and eight pointed stars and the grip and throw each one needs from a qi-using student.
